This allows for focused review and strengthens memory through pattern recognition and categorization.

##Apply the "spaced repetition" method to key facts  
Identify the most unique or distinctive facts—such as her being the only woman to win gold at both Rouen and Dresden, or her mural being considered more successful than Cassatt’s—and review them at increasing intervals. This leverages the document’s specific achievements to build long-term retention.
